crossRefs.note: that you might fear Yahweh your God, to keep all his statutes and his commandments, which I command you—you, your son…
to keep Yahweh’s commandments and statutes, which I command you today for your good?
If you are righteous, what do you give him? Or what does he receive from your hand?
Your wickedness may hurt a man as you are, and your righteousness may profit a son of man.
If you are wise, you are wise for yourself. If you mock, you alone will bear it.
Tell the righteous “Good!” For they shall eat the fruit of their deeds.
I will give them one heart and one way, that they may fear me forever, for their good, and the good of their children…
But seek first God’s Kingdom, and his righteousness; and all these things will be given to you as well.
What fruit then did you have at that time in the things of which you are now ashamed? For the end of those things is…
But now, being made free from sin and having become servants of God, you have your fruit of sanctification and the…
Now, Israel, listen to the statutes and to the ordinances which I teach you, to do them; that you may live, and go in…
But you who were faithful to Yahweh your God are all alive today.
You shall observe to do all the commandments which I command you today, that you may live, and multiply, and go in and…
He humbled you, allowed you to be hungry, and fed you with manna, which you didn’t know, neither did your fathers know…
Yahweh will preserve him, and keep him alive. He shall be blessed on the earth, and he will not surrender him to the…
who preserves our life among the living, and doesn’t allow our feet to be moved.
The result of humility and the fear of Yahweh is wealth, honor, and life.
For Moses writes about the righteousness of the law, “The one who does them will live by them.”

translations.web: Yahweh commanded us to do all these statutes, to fear Yahweh our God, for our good always, that he might preserve us alive, as we are today.
translations.bsb: And the LORD commanded us to observe all these statutes and to fear the LORD our God, that we may always be prosperous and preserved, as we are to this day.
translations.kjv: And the LORD commanded us to do all these statutes, to fear the LORD our God, for our good always, that he might preserve us alive, as it is at this day.
translations.asv: And Jehovah commanded us to do all these statutes, to fear Jehovah our God, for our good always, that he might preserve us alive, as at this day.
